alignmentPolicy.algorithm: prefix dynamic programming over low-to-high source and target sequences
alignmentPolicy.optimalSubstructureRule: one predecessor per 2D cell requires extension-stable selection axes; a running maximum is reported but cannot rank prefixes

operationPathShape.comparison: operation rank, then source ordinal, then target ordinal, over the complete path

alignmentPolicy.crossingRule: impossible because each match advances both prefixes
alignmentPolicy.lockRule: a locked source cannot leave and its resolved target cannot enter or match another source
alignmentPolicy.wallTimeRule: elapsed time cannot truncate work or change selection

costPolicy.maximumAbsoluteLeap: maximum matched absoluteSemitones, or zero with no matches
costPolicy.commonTonesLost: pitch-class multiset intersection size minus pitchClassCommonTones
costPolicy.guideToneContinuities: count matched exact non-null guide degree continuities
costPolicy.guideTonesLost: source guide-tone voice occurrences minus guideToneContinuities
costPolicy.crowdedLowIntervals: count adjacent target intervals below the inherited V0 band minimum
costPolicy.doubledGuideTones: sum target exact guide-degree multiplicity above one
costPolicy.omittedColors: count declared exact target color degrees absent from target voices
costPolicy.totalSpan: highest target MIDI minus lowest target MIDI

rolePolicy.guideSource: selected T1 realization guide degrees bound through V0 candidate evidence
rolePolicy.colorSource: degrees explicitly labeled color by the selected V0 template/role projection

identityPolicy.spelledPitch: step, alteration, and octave are equal
identityPolicy.degree: number and alteration are equal, including exact null handling
identityPolicy.guideToneContinuity: both endpoints are guides with equal non-null exact degrees
identityPolicy.gapIdentity: identity fields are null and commonTone/guideToneContinuity are false

relations.predicate: both nonzero signed motions are equal
both nonzero signs agree but signed motions differ

identityLifecycle.initialize: allocate voice-0000 upward in low-to-high order
identityLifecycle.match: propagate one exact identity and serial
identityLifecycle.enter: allocate after path selection in target order
identityLifecycle.requestBoundary: a new request must initialize a new namespace
identityLifecycle.pathSelectionCapacityInput: excluded: choose the canonical musical path without namespace serial capacity
identityLifecycle.capacityFallback: none: never select a lower-ranked musical path to conserve serials
identityLifecycle.selectionInvariance: namespace serial cannot change the canonical musical path while allocation is feasible
